snippet.title: Project Red Sun Demo | Gameplay Preview
snippet.description:
Wishlist Project Red Sun on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3437690/Project_Red_Sun/

The following is a preview of the Project Red Sun Demo.  All footage is captured on a PC.  This is a work-in-progress build and many aspects may be subject to change before the demo's release.


For more up-to-date information join our discord or follow us on social media.

Discord: https://discord.gg/GjP49D9AXM
Twitter: https://twitter.com/Fleetwood_Zak
